summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError(Exception), following the seven-step workflow in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes (including Literal -> TypeError) plus a non-node test for None and a plain string; each test checks the graph's triple count is unchanged. Results: the new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) under the prepared venv. Not verified: black, isort, flake8, and mypy are not installed in that venv and were not installed, so formatting and type-ignore placement were checked by reading only. Choices: non-str input (including None) is rejected up front with SHACLPathError to avoid None acting as a graph wildcard; optional lookups are narrowed before use. Nothing was committed.
